description: Demolition of three pre-fabricated garages and construction of new single garage to rear of 50 & 52 Beechcroft Avenue
decision_conditions: <p class="MsoNormal">The garage hereby permitted shall be used for&nbsp;storage only and for no other purposes.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">225088/02,
225088/01, 225088/03, Flood risk assessment, Reasonable Exception Statement.</span>

<p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced (other than</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">demolition works) until works for the disposal of surface water and works</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">for surface water attenuation and storage have been submitted to, and</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">approved in writing by, the local planning authority.</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
